subject: Page Buldini City Council Candidacy
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Page Buldini, a small business owner and Chamber of Commerce board member running for Medford City Council, about her platform, goals, and views on key city issues.

items.title: Introduction and Candidate Background
items.summary: Page Buldini introduced herself as a Medford resident of over 15 years, a local skincare salon owner, a public school parent, and a board member of the Chamber of Commerce.

items.title: Campaign Platform and Solutions
items.summary: Buldini discussed her support for ward representation on the ballot, her call for a slow, phased approach to zoning reform, and the need for dedicated liaisons to Medford's fire, police, school, and DPW workers.

items.title: Running as an Independent
items.summary: Buldini explained that she is running as an independent to maintain an open mind and represent the entire community rather than joining an aligned political group.

items.title: Economic Growth and Supporting Small Business
items.summary: Buldini outlined proposals to boost economic growth, including targeted commercial zoning, tourism promotion, and a developer engagement program in collaboration with the Chamber of Commerce.

items.title: Town-Gown Relations with Tufts University
items.summary: Buldini expressed a desire to strengthen Medford's relationship with Tufts University by negotiating a permanent PILOT program and expanding student internship opportunities.

items.title: Upcoming Community Events and Contact Information
items.summary: Buldini promoted upcoming city events like National Night Out and Run Medford, and shared her campaign contact details before the show concluded.
